Running Python code interactively: # Now decode the payload after MAC header
payload = data[15:]
print(f"Payload hex: {payload.hex()}")
print(f"Payload length: {len(payload)}")
print()

# This is likely 6LoWPAN compressed IPv6 + UDP + MLE
# First byte: 0x7f - let me check what dispatch this is
print(f"First byte: 0x{payload[0]:02x}")

# 6LoWPAN dispatch types:
# 0x60-0x7f = IPHC (IP Header Compression)
# Let's look at it as IPHC
# IPHC starts with 011xxxxx
# 0x7f = 0111 1111
# So it IS IPHC (starts with 011)

iphc1 = payload[0]
iphc2 = payload[1]
print(f"IPHC byte 1: 0x{iphc1:02x} = {iphc1:08b}")
print(f"IPHC byte 2: 0x{iphc2:02x} = {iphc2:08b}")

# IPHC1:
# bits 7-5: 011 (dispatch)
# bit 4: TF (Traffic Class/Flow) 
# bit 3: NH (Next Header) - 1=compressed
# bits 2-1: HLIM
# bit 0: CID (Context Identifier Extension)

# IPHC2:
# bit 7: SAC (Source Address Compression)
# bits 6-5: SAM (Source Address Mode)
# bit 4: M (Multicast)
# bit 3: DAC (Destination Address Compression)  
# bits 2-1: DAM (Destination Address Mode)

# 0x7f = 0111 1111
# dispatch = 011
# TF = 1 (traffic class and flow label elided)
# NH = 1 (next header compressed, use NHC)
# HLIM = 11 (1 hop)
# CID = 1 (context identifier extension present)

# 0x3b = 0011 1011
# SAC = 0
# SAM = 01 (64 bits inline - from IID)
# M = 1
# DAC = 1 
# DAM = 01

print()
print(f"TF: {(iphc1 >> 4) & 1}")
print(f"NH: {(iphc1 >> 3) & 1}")
print(f"HLIM: {iphc1 & 0x03}")
print(f"CID: {(iphc1 >> 0) & 1}")  # Wait, CID is bit 0 of first byte?

# Actually, IPHC encoding per RFC 6282:
# Byte 1: 011T FHNL   where 011 is dispatch, TF=traffic class bits, NH=next header, HLIM=2 bits
# Wait let me re-read RFC 6282

# Bits (from MSB to LSB of 2-byte header):
# 15-13: 011 (dispatch prefix)
# 12-11: TF (Traffic Class, Flow Label)
# 10: NH (Next Header)
# 9-8: HLIM (Hop Limit)
# 7: CID (Context Identifier Extension)
# 6: SAC (Source Address Compression)
# 5-4: SAM (Source Address Mode)
# 3: M (Multicast Compression)
# 2: DAC (Destination Address Compression)
# 1-0: DAM (Dest Address Mode)

iphc = (iphc1 << 8) | iphc2
print(f"\nIPHC 16-bit: 0x{iphc:04x} = {iphc:016b}")
print(f"Dispatch: {(iphc >> 13) & 0x7:03b}")
print(f"TF: {(iphc >> 11) & 0x3}")
print(f"NH: {(iphc >> 10) & 0x1}")
print(f"HLIM: {(iphc >> 8) & 0x3}")
print(f"CID: {(iphc >> 7) & 0x1}")
print(f"SAC: {(iphc >> 6) & 0x1}")
print(f"SAM: {(iphc >> 4) & 0x3}")
print(f"M: {(iphc >> 3) & 0x1}")
print(f"DAC: {(iphc >> 2) & 0x1}")
print(f"DAM: {(iphc >> 0) & 0x3}")
